key_point: Metroid hid that its hero was a woman, even in the manual
title: The Metroid manual called Samus "he" to hide that she was a woman.
caption: The Metroid manual called Samus "he" to hide that she was a woman. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #metroid #samusaran #nintendo

instagram.caption:
The Metroid manual called Samus "he" to hide that she was a woman.

In 1986 players spent the whole game as an armored bounty hunter, never seeing a face.

If you finished fast enough, the armor came off in the ending. It was one of gaming's first big twists, and most players only heard about it from friends.

Did you know before you saw it?
